m01.question: How much did we sell in 2018?
m01.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0) AS revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_date)s::date
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  %(end_date)s::date + 1
  AND (%(state)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_state = %(state)s::text)
  AND (%(category)s::text IS NULL OR p.category = %(category)s::text)

m15.question: What percentage of our customers placed more than one order?
m15.sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_date)s::date
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  %(end_date)s::date + 1
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders >= 2) AS repeat_customers,
       COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customer_orders

m17.question: Of the orders placed in 2017 that were delivered, what percentage arrived late?
m17.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date
       ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS late_rate_pct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date
       ) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_date)s::date
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  %(end_date)s::date + 1
  AND (%(state)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_state = %(state)s::text)

f01.question: For delivered orders that contain at least one bed_bath_table item, how much was paid in total with each payment type?
f01.sql: SELECT op.payment_type, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_paid_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN order_payments AS op ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' AS DATE) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id AND p.category = 'bed_bath_table') GROUP BY op.payment_type ORDER BY op.payment_type LIMIT 200

f02.question: What is the total payment value of delivered orders that have more than one item?
f02.sql: SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM orders AS o JOIN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS oi_multi ON oi_multi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN order_payments AS op ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 200

f03.question: What is the average total payment per delivered order, for orders that include a health_beauty item?
f03.sql: WITH hb_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND p.category = 'health_beauty') SELECT AVG(pay_total) AS avg_total_payment FROM (SELECT op.order_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS pay_total FROM order_payments AS op JOIN hb_orders AS h ON h.order_id = op.order_id GROUP BY op.order_id) AS sub LIMIT 200
